name: StarBoard
summary: Rank your GitHub repositories by stars and track star and fork changes locally.

privacyDisclosure.websiteSession: The browser attaches github.com cookies to website-source requests. StarBoard never reads or stores cookie values.
privacyDisclosure.tokenHandling: PATs are session-only by default, sent only to api.github.com, never exported, and can be explicitly persisted or forgotten.
privacyDisclosure.retention: Settings, repository snapshots, comparison baselines, saved portfolio views, and bounded daily history stay in the browser profile until the user clears them or uninstalls the extension.
privacyDisclosure.portableFiles: Backup and CSV export are user-initiated. Private repository names and history require separate opt-ins; known private names are redacted from default saved-view exports; PATs are never included.
privacyDisclosure.notifications: Local milestone and growth alerts are disabled by default. Chrome notification access is requested only when the user opts in.

permissions.name: storage
permissions.justification: Persist local settings, last-known-good repository snapshots, comparison baselines, bounded daily history, and short-lived undo state.

permissions.name: alarms
permissions.justification: Run the user-selected local refresh schedule and bounded retry.

permissions.name: offscreen
permissions.justification: Parse github.com HTML with DOMParser when the optional website source is active.

permissions.name: https://api.github.com/*
permissions.justification: Provide the secondary REST data source.

permissions.name: https://github.com/*
permissions.justification: Read repository pages only after the user chooses the default website source and grants access.

permissions.name: notifications
permissions.justification: Show local milestone or minimum-growth alerts only after the user enables them in Settings.
